40264-regiment-of-women.title: Regiment Of Women
40264-regiment-of-women.creator: Clemence Dane
40264-regiment-of-women.description: A book by Clemence Dane. Henrietta Vigers was spare, precise, with pale, twitching eyes and a high voice. Her manner was self-sufficient, her speech deliberate and unnecessarily correct: her effect was the colourless obstinacy of an elderly mule. She stared about her inquisitively.

62128-a-grammar-of-colloquial-chinese-as.title: Shanghai Dialect
62128-a-grammar-of-colloquial-chinese-as.creator: Unknown
62128-a-grammar-of-colloquial-chinese-as.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The mandarin student will meet with scarcely any new idioms here. Of words, there are a few tens not used in the fashionable colloquial. It is in sounds that the greatest variation exists, and an attempt has therefore been made to form a correct nomenclature for tones, and for the alphabetic elements of spoken words.

arxiv-2106-08802.title: A transmission hologram for slitless spectrophotometry on a convergent telescope beam. 1. Focus and resolution. 2021 A transmission hologram for slitless spectrophotometry on a convergent telescope beam. 1. Focus and resolution. – 27
arxiv-2106-08802.creator: M. Moniez, J. Neveu, S. Dagoret-Campagne, Y. Gentet, L. Le Guillou, The LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
arxiv-2106-08802.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Moniez, J. Neveu, S. Dagoret-Campagne, Y. Gentet, L. Le Guillou, The LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration. We report in this paper the test of a plane holographic optical element to be used as an aberration-corrected grating for a slitless spectrograph, inserted in a convergent telescope beam. Our long term objective is the optimisation of a specific hologram to switch the auxiliary telescope imager of the Vera Rubin Observatory into an accurate slitless spectrograph, dedicated to the atmospheric transmission measurement.

arxiv-2201-06228.title: Ternary Metal Oxide Substrates for Superconducting Circuits
arxiv-2201-06228.creator: Zach Degnan, Xin He, Alejandro Gomez Frieiro, Yauhen P. Sachkou, Arkady Fedorov, Peter Jacobson
arxiv-2201-06228.description: Abstract Substrate material imperfections and surface losses are one of the major factors limiting superconducting quantum circuitry from reaching the scale and complexity required to build a practicable quantum computer. One potential path towards higher coherence of superconducting quantum devices is to explore new substrate materials with a reduced density of imperfections due to inherently different surface chemistries.

arxiv-2203-09586.title: Ideal spaces: An extension of structure spaces of rings
arxiv-2203-09586.creator: Themba Dube, Amartya Goswami
arxiv-2203-09586.description: Abstract . Can there be a structure space-type theory for an arbitrary class of ideals of a ring? The ideal spaces introduced in this paper allows such a study and our theory includes (but not restricted to) prime, maximal, minimal prime, strongly irreducible, irreducible, completely irreducible, proper, minimal, primary, nil, nilpotent, regular, radical, principal, finitely generated ideals.

arxiv-2208-09699.title: An Approach of Adjusting the Switch Probability based on Dimension Size: A Case Study for Performance Improvement of the Flower Pollination Algorithm
arxiv-2208-09699.creator: Tahsin Aziz, Tashreef Muhammad, Md. Rashedul Karim Chowdhury, Mohammad Shafiul Alam
arxiv-2208-09699.description: Abstract Numerous meta-heuristic algorithms have been influenced by nature. Over the past couple of decades, their quantity has been significantly escalating. The majority of these algorithms attempt to emulate natural biological and physical phenomena. This research concentrates on the Flower Pollination algorithm, which is one of several bio-inspired algorithms.

arxiv-2211-10615.title: Exploring the Confounding Factors of Academic Career Success: An Empirical Study with Deep Predictive Modeling
arxiv-2211-10615.creator: Chenguang Du, Deqing Wang, Fuzhen Zhuang, Hengshu Zhu
arxiv-2211-10615.description: Abstract Understanding determinants of success in academic careers is critically important to both scholars and their employing organizations. While considerable research efforts have been made in this direction, there is still a lack of a quantitative approach to modeling the academic careers of scholars due to the massive confounding factors.

arxiv-2307-00504.title: On efficient computation in active inference
arxiv-2307-00504.creator: Aswin Paul, Noor Sajid, Lancelot Da Costa and Adeel Razi
arxiv-2307-00504.description: Abstract Despite being recognized as neurobiologically plausible, active inference faces difficulties when employed to simulate intelligent behaviour in complex environments due to its computational cost and the difficulty of specifying an appropriate target distribution for the agent. This paper introduces two solutions that work in concert to address these limitations.

arxiv-2408-13081.title: Magnetic correlations and Griffith-like phase in Co 2 TiSi 0.5 Al 0.5 Heusler alloy
arxiv-2408-13081.creator: Priyanka Yadav, Brajesh K. Mani, Rajendra S. Dhaka
arxiv-2408-13081.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Priyanka Yadav, Brajesh K. Mani, Rajendra S. Dhaka. We present a comprehensive study aimed at elucidating the complex magnetic correlations in Co 2 TiSi 0.5 Al 0.5 Heusler alloy having the partial B2-type structure amid L2 1 cubic main phase. The thermo-magnetization measurements at 100 Oe reveal the presence of two magnetic transitions at T C1 = 278 K \rm{}_{C1}=278~K and T C2 = 270 K \rm{}_{C2}=270~K , respectively, with saturation magnetization of around 1.2 μ B \mu\rm_{B} /f.u.

arxiv-2409-05036.title: Estimating velocities of infectious disease spread through spatio-temporal log-Gaussian Cox point processes
arxiv-2409-05036.creator: Fernando Rodriguez Avellaneda
arxiv-2409-05036.description: Abstract Understanding the spread of infectious diseases such as COVID-19 is crucial for informed decision-making and resource allocation. A critical component of disease behavior is the velocity with which disease spreads, defined as the rate of change between time and space. This paper proposes a spatio-temporal modeling approach to determine the velocities of infectious disease spread.

arxiv-2505-21040.title: FCKT: Fine-Grained Cross-Task Knowledge Transfer with Semantic Contrastive Learning for Targeted Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2505-21040.creator: Wei Chen, Zhao Zhang, Meng Yuan, Kepeng Xu, Fuzhen Zhuang
arxiv-2505-21040.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the task of targeted sentiment analysis (TSA), which involves two sub-tasks, i.e., identifying specific aspects from reviews and determining their corresponding sentiments. Aspect extraction forms the foundation for sentiment prediction, highlighting the critical dependency between these two tasks for effective cross-task knowledge transfer.

arxiv-2506-02743.title: KA-TP-16-2025
arxiv-2506-02743.creator: FR-PHENO-2025-006
arxiv-2506-02743.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by FR-PHENO-2025-006. The higher-order corrections for the SM-like Higgs boson mass and the trilinear Higgs self-couplings in the Next-to-Minimal Supersymmetric extension of the Standard Model (NMSSM) with Inverse Seesaw Mechanism are significant and highly correlated. We present here the full one-loop corrections to the trilinear Higgs self-couplings supplemented by the dominant top-Yukawa and strong coupling induced two-loop corrections from our previous calculations in the complex NMSSM. These corrections are performed consistently with the corresponding Higgs boson mass corrections.

arxiv-2507-04043.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Large Language Models in Solving Simple Programming Tasks: A User-Centered Study
arxiv-2507-04043.creator: Kai Deng
arxiv-2507-04043.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) become more common in educational tools and programming environments, questions arise about how these systems should interact with users. This study investigates how different interaction styles with ChatGPT-4o (passive, proactive, and collaborative) affect user performance on simple programming tasks.

arxiv-2511-13891.title: Weakly Supervised Ephemeral Gully Detection In Remote Sensing Images Using Vision Language Models
arxiv-2511-13891.creator: Seyed Mohamad Ali Tousi, John A. Lory, G. N. DeSouza
arxiv-2511-13891.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seyed Mohamad Ali Tousi, John A. Lory, G. N. DeSouza. Among soil erosion problems, Ephemeral Gullies are one of the most concerning phenomena occurring in agricultural fields. Their short temporal cycles increase the difficulty in automatically detecting them using classical computer vision approaches and remote sensing. Also, due to scarcity of and the difficulty in producing accurate labeled data, automatic detection of ephemeral gullies using Machine Learning is limited to zero-shot approaches which are hard to implement.

europmc-pmc4579482.title: Whole-genome sequencing for prediction of Mycobacterium tuberculosis drug susceptibility and resistance: a retrospective cohort study.
europmc-pmc4579482.creator: Walker TM, Kohl TA, Omar SV, Hedge J, Del Ojo Elias C, Bradley P, Iqbal Z, Feuerriegel S, Niehaus KE, Wilson DJ, Clifton DA, Kapatai G, Ip CLC, Bowden R, Drobniewski FA, Allix-Béguec C, Gaudin C, Parkhill J, Diel R, Supply P, Crook DW, Smith EG, Walker AS, Ismail N, Niemann S, Peto TEA, Modernizing Medical Microbiology (MMM) Informatics Group.
europmc-pmc4579482.description: Background Diagnosing drug-resistance remains an obstacle to the elimination of tuberculosis. Phenotypic drug-susceptibility testing is slow and expensive, and commercial genotypic assays screen only common resistance-determining mutations. We used whole-genome sequencing to cha

pmc-10669468.title: Calcium Prevents Enhanced Degradation of Factor VIII in the Condition of Motion
pmc-10669468.creator: Haim Cohen, Anat Keren-Politansky, Yonatan Crispel, Chen Yanovich, Keren Asayag, Yona Nadir, Arnold Spek
pmc-10669468.description: Simple SummaryIn the present work, calcium was found to prevent degradation of factor VIII during intermittent motion. In addition, calcium supplementation in drinking water consumed by mice increased factor VIII in blood and striated muscle. The clinical relevance of this work is that oral calcium may be evaluated as a potential supportive therapy in hemophilia patients.

pmc-11500429.title: Rank-Reduced Equation-of-Motion Coupled Cluster Triples: an Accurate and Affordable Way of Calculating Electronic Excitation Energies
pmc-11500429.creator: Piotr Michalak, Michał Lesiuk
pmc-11500429.description: In the present work, we report an implementation of the rank-reduced equation-of-motion coupled cluster method with approximate triple excitations (RR-EOM-CC3). The proposed variant relies on tensor decomposition techniques in order to alleviate the high cost of computing and manipulating the triply excited amplitudes. In the RR-EOM-CC3 method, both ground-state and excited-state triple-excitation amplitudes are compressed according to the Tucker-3 format.

pmc-11691893.title: THE RAFT DEBATE: GETTING UNDERGRADUATE STUDENTS TO THINK CRITICALLY ABOUT AGING
pmc-11691893.creator: Andrew Fiscella
pmc-11691893.description: A student-centered approach has been advocated to help students develop as learners, as it allows students to think critically, beyond what might be required in an essay. However, it can be difficult to achieve in larger classes, where a teacher-centered approach is more often utilized.

pmc-12431515.title: Compilation of Load Spectrum of Loader Working Device and Application in Fatigue Life Prediction
pmc-12431515.creator: Xiaohua Shi, Wenming Guo, Jiyang Wang, Gang Li, Hao Lu, Jiawei Xiang
pmc-12431515.description: During the working process of the wheel loader, the repeated cycle of the shoveling and unloading process will produce an impact, so the loader is under a cyclic load for a long time, which leads to the frequent failure of its main parts.

pmc-12436473.title: Deprescribing for People with Dementia: A Roadmap
pmc-12436473.creator: Ariel R Green, Cynthia M Boyd, Rosalphie Quiles, Andrea E Daddato, Kathy Gleason, Tobie Taylor-McPhail, Aleksandra Wec, Stephanie K Nothelle, Rebecca S Boxer
pmc-12436473.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). People with dementia (PWD) are frequently exposed to polypharmacy and potentially inappropriate medication use, in which the risks of medication use outweigh the benefits or the medication is not aligned with treatment goals. Appropriate deprescribing of unnecessary or potentially inappropriate medications is essential to high-quality care for PWD, to avoid iatrogenic harm and improve health and well-being for patients and their care partners.

pmc-12614619.title: Experiences on the implementation and maintenance of the Canadian Disability Participation Project: A mixed-methods study
pmc-12614619.creator: Femke Hoekstra, Alanna Shwed, Sarah Lawrason, Kathleen A. Martin Ginis, Veronica Allan, Anita Kothari, Christopher B. McBride, Heather L. Gainforth, Ivan Sarmiento, Ivan Sarmiento, Ivan Sarmiento
pmc-12614619.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Establishing a multidisciplinary network of researchers, trainees, and research users—such as the Canadian Disability Participation Project (CDPP)—is a promising approach to promote and support research partnerships and improve the application of disability research findings. This study aimed to 1) describe the implementation of the CDPP network over time and 2) explore members’ experiences and reflections on the implementation and maintenance of the CDPP network and its partnerships.

pmc-12654233.title: Automatic Apparent Nasal Index from Single Facial Photographs Using a Lightweight Deep Learning Pipeline: A Pilot Study
pmc-12654233.creator: Babak Saravi, Lara Schorn, Julian Lommen, Max Wilkat, Andreas Vollmer, Hamza Eren Güzel, Michael Vollmer, Felix Schrader, Christoph K Sproll, Norbert R Kübler, Daman D Singh, Silviu Marinescu, Marius Eugen Ciurea
pmc-12654233.description: Background and Objectives: Quantifying nasal proportions is central to facial plastic and reconstructive surgery, yet manual measurements are time-consuming and variable. We sought to develop a simple, reproducible deep learning pipeline that localizes the nose in a single frontal photograph and automatically computes the two-dimensional, photograph-derived apparent nasal index (aNI)—width/height × 100—enabling classification into five standard anthropometric categories.

pmc-12682076.title: A case series of hyperthermia crisis in cough mixture ingestion: Why early cooling save lives
pmc-12682076.creator: Hon Chun, Tin Yat Anthony Chow
pmc-12682076.description: ObjectiveHyperthermia (core body temperature >40°C) associated with cough mixture ingestion has been reported in case studies. However, clinical data and consensus on treatment remain limited. This study aimed to identify associated factors, characterize clinical manifestations, and evaluate management approaches for hyperthermia following cough mixture ingestion.

pmc-13083524.title: End-to-End Multimodal Multiple Instance Learning for Cancer Histopathology Classification with Dual-Attention Fusion
pmc-13083524.creator: Satoshi Shirae, Shyam S Debsarkar, Hiroharu Kawanaka, Bruce J Aronow, V B Surya Prasath
pmc-13083524.description: In recent years, computational pathology has advanced toward integrating histopathological images and genomic data to improve diagnostic accuracy and biological interpretability. In this study, we propose a lightweight end-to-end multi-instance learning model that integrates whole slide images (WSIs) with gene expression profiles.

pmc-13685317.title: Cadmium-driven specific endophytic bacteria and their role in rice grains yield and cadmium accumulation
pmc-13685317.creator: Yibin Lai, Weijun Gong, Xiong Zeng, Salma Saeed Khan, James F White, Dezhi Yang, Rongbo Li, Haiyan Li
pmc-13685317.description: Background and aimsThe endophytic communities of plants are significantly influenced by heavy metal stress. Conversely, endophytes contribute to host plants’ heavy metal tolerance and accumulation. This study evaluates the impact of cadmium (Cd) on rice, and investigates the role of endophytes in Cd accumulation in rice.
